# Amigable Mascota

> Amigable Mascota is a comprehensive pet-friendly platform connecting pet owners with pet services, adoption opportunities, lost and found pets, pet-friendly places, and AI-powered pet name generation across multiple countries, states, and cities.

Amigable Mascota is a bilingual (Spanish/English) web platform designed to help pet owners find everything they need for their pets. The platform serves as a directory and marketplace for pet-related services, pet adoption, lost and found pets, and pet-friendly establishments. It operates across multiple geographic locations with location-based filtering and search capabilities.

The platform enables service providers (groomers, veterinarians, dog walkers, pet sitters, daycare centers, pet hotels) to register and list their services. Pet owners can search for services by location (country, state, city) and category. The platform also facilitates pet adoption by connecting potential adopters with pets in need of homes, and helps reunite lost pets with their owners through a community-driven lost and found system.

Additionally, Amigable Mascota features an AI-powered pet name generator that creates unique, culturally meaningful pet names with personality analysis. The platform includes pet-friendly place listings for hotels, restaurants, cafes, and parks that welcome pets. All content is bilingual, supporting both Spanish and English languages, and the platform uses structured data and SEO best practices to ensure discoverability.

## Sitemaps

- [Sitemap Index](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap.xml): Main sitemap index containing all sitemap references
- [Static Pages Sitemap](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-static.xml): Homepage, legal pages, pet names directory, and IA name generator
- [Location hubs — countries](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-locations-countries.xml): Country listing routes (`/{iso}`) with pagination
- [Location hubs — states](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-locations-states.xml): State listing routes with pagination
- [Location hubs — cities](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-locations-cities.xml): City listing routes with pagination
- [Neighborhood listings](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-neighborhoods.xml): Published neighborhood hubs and neighborhood + category routes
- [Categories Sitemap](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-categories.xml): All service category routes with location combinations and pagination
- [Pet Names Sitemap](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-pet-names.xml): Individual pet name pages with detailed information
- [Posts Sitemap](https://amigablemascota.com/sitemap-posts.xml): All active service listings, adoption posts, lost/found posts, and pet-friendly place listings

## Main Content Areas

- [Homepage](https://amigablemascota.com/): Location-aware homepage showing featured pet services and content
- [Publish Page](https://amigablemascota.com/publicar): Form to publish services, adoptions, lost/found pets, or pet-friendly places
- [Pet Names Directory](https://amigablemascota.com/nombres-para-mascotas): Browse and search pet names with AI-generated suggestions
- [AI Pet Name Generator](https://amigablemascota.com/generar-nombres-de-mascotas-con-ia): Generate unique pet names using artificial intelligence
- [Privacy Policy](https://amigablemascota.com/informacion/privacidad): Privacy policy and data protection information
- [Terms of Service](https://amigablemascota.com/informacion/terminos): Terms and conditions of use

## Service Categories

- [Dog Grooming](https://amigablemascota.com/peluqueria-para-perros): Professional dog grooming services
- [Cat Grooming](https://amigablemascota.com/peluqueria-para-gatos): Professional cat grooming services
- [Dog Daycare](https://amigablemascota.com/guarderias-para-perros): Daycare centers for dogs
- [Cat Daycare](https://amigablemascota.com/guarderias-para-gatos): Daycare centers for cats
- [Dog Walkers](https://amigablemascota.com/paseadores-de-perros): Professional dog walking services
- [Dogs for Adoption](https://amigablemascota.com/perros-en-adopcion): Dogs available for adoption
- [Cats for Adoption](https://amigablemascota.com/gatos-en-adopcion): Cats available for adoption
- [Lost and Found Dogs](https://amigablemascota.com/perros-perdidos-y-encontrados): Lost and found dog listings
- [Lost and Found Cats](https://amigablemascota.com/gatos-perdidos-y-encontrados): Lost and found cat listings
- [Dog Hotels and Daycare](https://amigablemascota.com/hoteles-y-guarderias-para-perros): Hotels and daycare centers for dogs
- [Cat Hotels and Daycare](https://amigablemascota.com/hoteles-y-guarderias-para-gatos): Hotels and daycare centers for cats
- [Pet Friendly Hotels](https://amigablemascota.com/hoteles-pet-friendly): Hotels that welcome pets
- [Pet Friendly Cafes and Restaurants](https://amigablemascota.com/cafeterias-y-restaurantes-pet-friendly): Cafes and restaurants that welcome pets
- [Pet Friendly Parks](https://amigablemascota.com/parques-pet-friendly): Parks and recreational areas for pets

## Location-Based Routes

Location routes follow the pattern: `/{country-iso2}`, `/{country-iso2}/{state-slug}`, `/{country-iso2}/{city-slug}`. Each location can be combined with categories: `/{country-iso2}/{category-slug}`, `/{country-iso2}/{state-slug}/{category-slug}`, `/{country-iso2}/{city-slug}/{category-slug}`. Individual service listings follow: `/{country-iso2}/{category-slug}/{post-slug}`.

## API Endpoints

- [Robots.txt](https://amigablemascota.com/robots.txt): Search engine crawler instructions
- [API Routes](https://amigablemascota.com/api/): RESTful API endpoints for platform functionality (authentication, posts, comments, categories, locations, pet names, users)

## Optional

- [Admin Panel](https://amigablemascota.com/admin/): Administrative interface for content moderation and platform management
- [User Profile](https://amigablemascota.com/profile/): User account management and pet profile creation
- [Authentication](https://amigablemascota.com/auth/): User registration, login, and email verification
